sn47.8:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, bālo avyatto akusalo sūdo rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattaṃ vā nānaccayehi sūpehi paccupaṭṭhito assa:
sn47.8:1.2: ambilaggehipi tittakaggehipi kaṭukaggehipi madhuraggehipi khārikehipi akhārikehipi loṇikehipi aloṇikehipi.
sn47.8:2.1: sakho so bhikkhave, bālo avyatto akusalo sūdo sakassa bhattu nimittaṃ na uggaṇhāti:
sn47.8:2.2: idaṃ vā me ajja bhattu sūpeyyaṃ ruccati, imassa vā abhiharati, imassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti, imassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
sn47.8:2.3: ambilaggaṃ vā me ajja bhattu sūpeyyaṃ ruccati, ambilaggassa vā abhiharati, ambilaggassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti, ambilaggassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, tittakaggaṃ vā me ajja bhattu …pe… kaṭukaggaṃ vā me ajja bhattu …pe… madhuraggaṃ vā me ajja bhattu …pe… khārikaṃ vā me ajja bhattu …pe… akhārikaṃ vā me ajja bhattu …pe… loṇikaṃ vā me ajja bhattu …pe… aloṇikaṃ vā me ajja bhattu sūpeyyaṃ ruccati, aloṇikassa vā abhiharati, aloṇikassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti, aloṇikassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatīti.
sn47.8:3.1: sakho so bhikkhave, bālo avyatto akusalo sūdo naceva lābhī hoti: acchādanassa, na lābhī vetanassa, na lābhī abhihārānaṃ.
sn47.8:3.3: tathā hi so bhikkhave, bālo avyatto akusalo sūdo sakassa bhattu nimittaṃ na uggaṇhāti.
sn47.8:3.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, idhekacco bālo avyatto akusalo bhikkhu kāye na kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.8:3.5: tassa kāye na kāyānupassino viharato cittaṃ na samādhiyati, upakkilesā na pahīyanti.
sn47.8:3.9: dhammesu na dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.8:3.10: tassa dhammesu na dhammānupassino viharato cittaṃ na samādhiyati, upakkilesā na pahīyanti.
sn47.8:4.1: sakho so bhikkhave, bālo avyatto akusalo bhikkhu naceva lābhī hoti diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ, na lābhī satisampajaññassa.
sn47.8:4.3: tathā hi so bhikkhave, bālo avyatto akusalo bhikkhu sakassa cittassa nimittaṃ na uggaṇhāti.
sn47.8:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, paṇḍito viyatto kusalo sūdo rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattaṃ vā nānaccayehi sūpehi paccupaṭṭhito assa:
sn47.8:5.2: ambilaggehipi tittakaggehipi kaṭukaggehipi madhuraggehipi khārikehipi akhārikehipi loṇikehipi aloṇikehipi.
sn47.8:6.1: sakho so bhikkhave, paṇḍito viyatto kusalo sūdo sakassa bhattu nimittaṃ uggaṇhāti:
sn47.8:6.2: “idaṃ vā me ajja bhattu sūpeyyaṃ ruccati, imassa vā abhiharati, imassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti, imassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
sn47.8:6.3: ambilaggaṃ vā me ajja bhattu sūpeyyaṃ ruccati, ambilaggassa vā abhiharati, ambilaggassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti, ambilaggassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. tittakaggaṃ vā me ajja bhattu …pe… kaṭukaggaṃ vā me ajja bhattu …pe… madhuraggaṃ vā me ajja bhattu …pe… khārikaṃ vā me ajja bhattu …pe… akhārikaṃ vā me ajja bhattu …pe… loṇikaṃ vā me ajja bhattu …pe… aloṇikaṃ vā me ajja bhattu sūpeyyaṃ ruccati, aloṇikassa vā abhiharati, aloṇikassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti, aloṇikassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatīti.
sn47.8:7.1: sakho so bhikkhave, paṇḍito viyatto kusalo sūdo lābhī ceva hoti acchādanassa, lābhī vetanassa, lābhī abhihārānaṃ.
sn47.8:7.3: tathā hi so bhikkhave, paṇḍito vyatto kusalo sūdo sakassa bhattu nimittaṃ uggaṇhāti.
sn47.8:7.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, idhekacco paṇḍito viyatto kusalo bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.8:7.5: tassa kāye kāyānupassino viharato cittaṃ samādhiyati, upakkilesā pahīyanti.
sn47.8:7.9: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.8:7.10: tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato cittaṃ samādhiyati, upakkilesā pahīyanti.
sn47.8:8.1: sakho so bhikkhave, paṇḍito viyatto kusalo bhikkhu lābhī ceva hoti diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ, lābhī hoti satisampajaññassa.
sn47.8:8.3: tathā hi so bhikkhave, paṇḍito vyatto kusalo bhikkhu sakassa cittassa nimittaṃ uggaṇhātīti.
